:::{#def-validation-error}
#### Validation error

The **validation error** of a [prediction rule](#def-prediction-rule) $\fitted$
fitted to a [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$
is the [mean squared error](prediction.qmd#def-prediction-mse)
of its predictions for the [validation set](#def-validation-set),
indexed by $\validx$:

$$
\valerr \eqdef \frac{1}{\abs{\validx}} \sum_{\iobs \in \validx} \sqf{\fitted\paren{\predvar_{\iobs}} - \outvar_{\iobs}}.
$$ {#eq-validation-error}

:::
